scenes.text: Watch and read: Ama asks: Ama is sharing an idea in a group. When should you speak?
The answer is: When your partner has finished. Conversation needs listening and turn-taking.
Watch and read: Ama asks: You did not understand: “Ama says the book is near the school.” What should you ask?
The answer is: Could you explain that, please?. Ask politely when meaning is not clear.
